scope: Canonical perspective selection, full-file chart handoff, and governed deep BA presentation

findings.before: Every perspective with a governed action was labeled Recommended.
findings.after: Exactly one deterministic ready perspective is recommended; all other perspectives remain explicit user choices.

findings.before: A recognized-only perspective was labeled Understood, which could imply analysis support.
findings.after: Recognized-only perspectives are labeled Evidence found and do not fabricate questions or charts.

findings.before: An authorized action could open Investigation without auto-running when preview rows were not retained, even though the full runtime source was available.
findings.after: Each authorized investigation session invokes the canonical execution handler exactly once; source continuity and runtime preflight remain authoritative.

findings.before: Deep BA used governed result rows but did not receive the canonical metric, perspective, full-file scope, limitations, evidence, or decision-use restrictions.
findings.after: Deep BA carries governed execution context, prioritizes limitations and restrictions, caps non-authorized decision readiness, and requires business-owner validation before action.

safetyPreserved: No action is shown without governed question and runtime preflight
No auto-run when the handoff is not executable
No decision-use authorization inferred from successful metric execution
No recognized-only perspective promoted to a chart
